_comment: Config for the Dockerized Pagila DB (see docker-compose.yml). Uses the read-only npx Postgres MCP server so no `uv` is required. Start the DB with `docker compose up -d`, then run the agent/UI against this config.
_windows_note: On Windows the command must be `npx.cmd` (the .cmd shim); on macOS/Linux use `npx`.
